attchmntText: Blue Dart Express Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 20, 2026, titled "Blue Dart Connects Srinagar to India and the World Through Its Express Network".
voiceSummary: Blue Dart Express Limited issued a press release on November 20, 2026, announcing the launch of next-day delivery services from Srinagar to five major metropolitan cities in India. The company established its first Service Centre in Jammu and Kashmir to support this expansion. Delivery is available within 24 hours, subject to terms and conditions. The initiative aims to connect local businesses, including artisans and MSMEs, to domestic and international markets via Blue Dart’s network covering 220 countries. The release highlights potential benefits for sectors such as Pashmina weaving, handicrafts, and agriculture in the Kashmir Valley. Blue Dart Express Limited is part of the DHL Group’s DHL eCommerce division.

attchmntText: Blue Dart Express Limited has informed the Exchange about Investor Presentation
voiceSummary: Blue Dart Express Limited filed an investor presentation with BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India on November 19, 2026, under Regulation 30 of the SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The presentation is also available on the company website at www.bluedart.com. The document outlines the company's vision, leadership, and investment case. It highlights Blue Dart as a market leader in India's express and parcels delivery sector. Key operational data for FY2025-26 includes sales of 61,409 mn, EBITDA of 6,492 mn, and EBT of 3,156 mn. The company covers 56,400 locations and processed 404 million shipments. The presentation details strategies for maintaining market leadership and growing the eCommerce segment. It also discusses structural market trends and the Indian macroeconomic outlook for 2026 and 2027.

attchmntText: Blue Dart Express Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Appointment of Mr Charles Simon Dobbie as an Additional Director (Non-Executive and Non-Independent)of the company w.e.f. November 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Blue Dart Express Limited has appointed Mr. Charles Simon Dobbie, DIN 10302056, as an Additional Director, Non-Executive, Non-Independent, with effect from November 30, 2026. The Board approved this appointment via Circular Resolution on November 19, 2026, based on the Nomination and Remuneration Committee's recommendation. Mr. Dobbie will hold office until the date of the ensuing Annual General Meeting or the last date by which it should have been held, whichever is earlier. He is not related to any existing Director of the Company and is not debarred from holding the office of Director.
